test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 30 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven kids, G, H, I, J, K, L and M, are sitting in a straight row facing north. Only two people sit to the right of H. Only three people sit between H and I. J sits to the immediate right of H and to the immediate left of G. K sits to the immediate right of L and is not a neighbour of H.

Who sits second from the extreme left end of the row?
solution: Given: Seven kids, G, H, I, J, K, L and M, are sitting in a straight row facing north. 1) Only two people sit to the right of H. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f59f5c463df06388e9f665c9ced4936c4ddee026e33613be53553f0cbedaa233.png] 2) Only three people sit between H and I.
